$comment: S23 data.gov.in variety-wise mandi prices (T270), resource 35985678-0d79-46b4-9ed6-6f13308a1d24. Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s23.yaml. Scope: State=Karnataka, Commodity=Onion only (other commodities need H16).

fields.name: market_id
fields.meaning: karnataka/<district>/<market> as published, lowercased; spelling variants stay separate until the T271 crosswalk

fields.name: commodity_code
fields.meaning: Commodity_Code as text (string before Nov 2025, integer after)

fields.name: date_local
fields.meaning: Arrival_Date (DD/MM/YYYY), equal to the per-day request filter

fields.name: min_inr_quintal
fields.meaning: Min_Price in Rs./Quintal as given; null if empty or not a number

fields.name: max_inr_quintal
fields.meaning: Max_Price in Rs./Quintal as given; null if empty or not a number

fields.name: modal_inr_quintal
fields.meaning: Modal_Price in Rs./Quintal as given; null with missing_reason not_reported (empty) or quality_rejected (not a number)

fields.name: price_unit
fields.meaning: Rs./Quintal (owner-observed AGMARKNET Price Unit for onion, D201)

excluded: No cleaning beyond schema validity: zero, out-of-order and per-kg-looking prices are kept as published for T271 to quarantine
record_id: SHA256 of the published record plus its occurrence number within the day, so identical rows are never merged
